## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable

[Sustainability][61]

## [Celebrating 10 years of Silo Art][90]

GrainCorp is celebrating ten years since it helped ignite Australia’s iconic silo art movement on
the east coast

## [From Paddock to Plane: Feedstock White Paper][92]

GrainCorp has released a new white paper that explores Australia’s readiness to build a domestic
sustainable aviation fuel industry from the paddock up. 

[Read the full White Paper ][93]

## [Reconciliation for the long term ][94]

GrainCorp has released its second Innovate Reconciliation Action Plan.

[Read our RAP][95]

## [Celebrating our values][96]

We recently refreshed our company values to better reflect the purpose of our business; to connect
with global markets, customers and rural communities to deliver value through innovation and
expertise.

[Watch now][97]

## [GrainCorp's 2025 Sustainability Report][98]

We made significant progress in our sustainability commitments in FY25.

[Read here][99]

## [GrainCorp - Agriculture. Nutrition. Energy][100]

[Watch here][101]

## Our Businesses

Underpinned by our grains and oilseed storage, handling and processing assets in eastern Australia,
we offer a global end-to-end supply chain, from origination to the end user.

Servicing more than 350 customers in more than 50 countries, we originate grain from Australia,
Canada, the UK and Ukraine, and connect directly with customers through overseas offices in
Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai and Delhi. With seven ports on east-coast Australia, we offer
high-speed long-distance rail export capability.

Our processing businesses service foods customers with edible oils that are specially blended for
infant formula, bakery and large-scale food manufacture.

Our bulk commodity business is Australia and New Zealand’s largest exporter tallow and Used Cooking
Oil (UCO), some of which is processed for upcycling into biofuel.

Meanwhile, our feeds businesses use edible oils and molasses-based products to boost farm
productivity.

### Serviceton (VIC)

Artists: Jack Fran
Completed in 2025

Serviceton VIC 3420, Australia

At the historic Serviceton Railway Station, a striking new silo mural brought a pivotal moment in
Australia’s past to life. Completed in November 2025 by artist Jack Fran, the work depicts a South
Australian farmer and a Victorian surveyor facing off across a bold white border line - one man
watching, the other carefully measuring the line that would spark decades of dispute. 

The mural honours the 1847 South Australian Victorian border error, when a surveying mistake placed
the boundary several kilometres west of the true 141st meridian, leaving Serviceton caught in the
middle. When the interstate railway arrived in the 1880s, the uncertainty was so great the station
had operated for both colonies, with duplicated offices and changing locomotives. 

Fran’s mural stands as both tribute and lesson, highlighting how a single misplaced line helped
shape a town, a railway, and the shared history of two states. The project was coordinated by
ArtAid, the creative team behind the Kaniva silo art mural, and has received strong support from the
West Wimmera Shire Council.

Close

### Kaniva (VIC)

Artists: David Lee Pereira Completed in 2020
Kaniva VIC 3419, Australia

Working 12-hour days, 7 days a week, artist David Lee Pereira finished up his vibrant masterpiece of
an Australian hobby falcon and sun orchids endemic to the region in just over three weeks.

“I wanted to paint images significant to Kaniva and that reflect on the rare beauty of the landscape
and uniqueness of the Little Desert,” David explains.

“The sun orchids only bloom for a few weeks in Spring and don't grow anywhere else in the world – a
reminder of their rarity and, without more conversations about conservation of our native flora and
fauna, they will disappear.

“Meanwhile, the Australian hobby is a symbol of the resilience and strength of our community – a
totem in  response to 2020 and the pandemic.”

It was fantastic to work with [Authority Creative][133], [David Lee Pereira art][134] and West
[Wimmera Shire Council][135] on another iconic silo art mural.

perfection. It features the Moonie River, an amazing Thallon sunset and the area’s agricultural
base. It also recognises members of Thallon’s indigenous community by the inclusion of a scarred
tree.

The overall inspiration for the mural comes from the work of three local photographers. They are
Chantel McAlister’s ‘First Light’, the ‘Moonie River’ by Lila Brosnan and Gary Petrie’s shot of two
pale face rosellas. ‘The Watering Hole’ was created from just a single A4 drawing, the imagination
of the artists Joel and Travis and the Thallon Community.

The giant mural, which covers four 30-metre-high silos took just three weeks to complete using about
500 litres of paint and 500 paint spray cans.

# MPO500 Link Alternatif Terbaru 2026: Mengintegrasikan Keamanan Digital dalam Ekosistem Teknologi
# Properti Modern

Perkembangan teknologi digital **[MPO500][3]** di tahun 2026 telah mengubah lanskap berbagai
industri global secara radikal, tidak terkecuali industri real estat dan properti. Jika satu dekade
lalu investasi dan pengelolaan properti masih sangat bergantung pada proses administrasi manual yang
memakan waktu, kini era Property Technology atau PropTech telah mengambil alih. Integrasi sistem
komputasi awan (cloud computing), kecerdasan buatan (AI), keamanan siber tingkat tinggi, hingga
jaringan server alternatif kini menjadi tulang punggung bagi efisiensi pengelolaan aset properti
modern.

Di tengah transformasi yang serba cepat ini, platform digital seperti **MPO500** terus menunjukkan
komitmennya dalam menghadirkan infrastruktur jaringan yang tangguh, aman, dan mudah diakses. Bagi
para pelaku bisnis digital dan manajemen aset, memahami fleksibilitas akses melalui **MPO500 Link
Alternatif** merupakan langkah krusial untuk menjaga kontinuitas operasional dari gangguan teknis
siber. Melalui sistem **MPO500 Login** yang terenkripsi, pengguna dapat menikmati ekosistem digital
yang stabil, responsif, dan adaptif terhadap perkembangan teknologi properti saat ini.

## Transformasi Jaringan Digital dalam Industri PropTech 2026

Industri properti modern saat ini tidak lagi sekadar berbicara tentang batu bata dan semen,
melainkan tentang bagaimana data aset dikelola, dipasarkan, dan dilindungi. Perusahaan PropTech
terkemuka di tahun 2026 sangat bergantung pada ketersediaan jaringan yang memiliki waktu aktif
(uptime) hingga 99,9%. Ketika sebuah situs utama mengalami pemeliharaan sistem (maintenance) atau
gangguan server global, operasional bisnis tidak boleh berhenti.

Untuk memberikan perlindungan berlapis, sistem login modern kini mendukung verifikasi ganda. Langkah
ini memastikan bahwa meskipun ada pihak lain yang mengetahui informasi akun Anda, mereka tetap tidak
dapat masuk tanpa kode verifikasi sekunder yang dikirimkan langsung ke perangkat pribadi Anda.

## Hubungan Efisiensi Infrastruktur Web dengan Kenaikan ROI Properti

Bagi pemilik platform properti seperti
`[https://redesignproperties.com/](https://redesignproperties.com/)`, kinerja sebuah situs web
berdampak langsung pada Return on Investment (ROI). Hubungan antara kecepatan akses web dan
keputusan konsumen sangatlah linier. Konsumen digital tahun 2026 memiliki tingkat kesabaran yang
sangat rendah terhadap situs web yang lambat atau sulit diakses.

Mari kita lihat bagaimana optimasi tautan dan stabilitas server memengaruhi performa bisnis:
* **Kecepatan Memuat Halaman (Page Load Speed):** Situs yang menggunakan teknologi server
  terdistribusi seperti **MPO500** mampu memuat visualisasi properti 3D, cetak biru arsitektur, dan
  simulasi biaya dalam hitungan milidetik. Kecepatan ini menurunkan bounce rate dan meningkatkan
  retensi pengunjung.
* **Aksesibilitas Tanpa Batas:** Dengan menyediakan **MPO500 Link Alternatif**, platform menjamin
  bahwa calon investor atau pengguna dari berbagai wilayah geografis tetap dapat mengakses layanan
  tanpa terhalang oleh pemblokiran penyedia jasa internet (ISP) lokal atau gangguan regulasi teknis.
* **Pengalaman Pengguna yang Mulus (Seamless UX):** Proses dari kunjungan awal, navigasi menu,
  hingga eksekusi pendaftaran atau transaksi melalui tombol login yang responsif menciptakan
  pengalaman pengguna yang memuaskan. Rasa percaya yang terbangun dari sistem yang andal ini adalah
  kunci konversi penjualan yang tinggi.

## 5 Fitur Utama Arsitektur Web MPO500 di Tahun 2026

Untuk mempertahankan posisinya sebagai platform digital yang andal, MPO500 mengadopsi arsitektur web
modern yang sejalan dengan perkembangan teknologi PropTech global. Berikut adalah lima fitur teknis
utama yang tertanam di dalam sistem link terbaru:

`[User Request] ──> [Smart Load Balancer] ──┬──> [Server Utama MPO500]
                                            └──> [MPO500 Link Alternatif (Backup)]
`
1. **Load Balancing Dinamis:** Teknologi yang membagi beban lalu lintas data secara merata ke
   beberapa klaster server cadangan. Jika satu server mengalami beban kerja berlebih, server
   alternatif akan otomatis mengambil alih tanpa interupsi.
2. **Desain Responsif Berbasis HTML5:** Seluruh interface platform dioptimalkan secara sempurna
   untuk semua jenis perangkat, baik itu komputer desktop, tablet, hingga smartphone (Android dan
   iOS).
3. **Penyimpanan Data Terdistribusi (Edge Caching):** Menggunakan jaringan pengiriman konten (CDN)
   global untuk menyimpan salinan statis dari situs web di lokasi geografis terdekat dengan
   pengguna, sehingga mempercepat waktu respons pengunduhan data.
4. **Sistem Pemantauan Otomatis (Auto-Healing Server):** Protokol kecerdasan buatan yang memantau
   kesehatan server selama 24 jam penuh. Jika terdeteksi adanya galat (error) sistem, teknologi ini
   akan melakukan perbaikan mandiri secara instan.
5. **Antarmuka Pengguna (UI) Minimalis Modern:** Tata letak menu dirancang dengan prinsip ergonomi
   digital untuk memastikan pengguna dapat menemukan menu utama, layanan bantuan, dan tombol login
   dengan sangat mudah tanpa visual yang membingungkan.

## Panduan Aman Menggunakan Link Alternatif

Di era digital yang serba terkoneksi ini, pengguna juga dituntut untuk selalu waspada terhadap upaya
penipuan berbasis manipulasi tautan (phishing). Banyak pihak tidak bertanggung jawab membuat domain
tiruan yang sekilas mirip dengan brand asli untuk mencuri data sensitif pengguna.

Berikut adalah panduan praktis agar Anda selalu aman saat ingin melakukan login atau pendaftaran:
* **Verifikasi Alamat Domain:** Sebelum memasukkan informasi akun Anda pada halaman **MPO500
  Login**, periksa kembali bilah alamat (address bar) browser Anda. Pastikan tautan tersebut berasal
  dari domain partner resmi yang sah, seperti
  `[https://redesignproperties.com/](https://redesignproperties.com/)`.
* **Perhatikan Simbol Gembok (HTTPS):** Pastikan situs web tersebut menggunakan protokol aman
  `https://` yang ditandai dengan ikon gembok terkunci di sebelah kiri URL. Jangan pernah memasukkan
  data apa pun di situs yang ditandai sebagai “Not Secure”.
* **Gunakan Saluran Komunikasi Resmi:** Jika Anda ragu dengan validitas sebuah tautan, selalu
  hubungi tim layanan pelanggan (Customer Service) yang aktif 24/7 melalui fitur Live Chat resmi
  untuk mendapatkan konfirmasi langsung mengenai daftar **MPO500 Link Alternatif** terbaru yang
  aktif.

Integrasi antara stabilitas jaringan, keamanan siber, dan kemudahan akses adalah tiga pilar utama
yang menentukan keberhasilan sebuah platform digital di tahun 2026. Baik dalam industri pengelolaan

## Home

## ** WHO WE ARE**

SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions and innovation for top brands, retailers and
foodservice providers across a broad portfolio of beverages, broths and better-for-you snacks.

[WHAT WE DO BEST]

## [WHAT WE DO BEST][150]

SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions that fuel and sustain our customers’ success.
Today SunOpta produces more than 200 organic certified products and 50 branded non-GMO Project
Verified products and ingredients.
[SUSTAINABILITY]

## [SUSTAINABILITY][151]

We aim to reduce our environmental footprint by finding solutions for more efficient use of
electricity, gas and water, achieving zero waste in our manufacturing facilities, developing
innovative packaging solutions, optimizing our transportation and responsibly sourcing our
ingredients.
[SAFETY AND QUALITY]

## [SAFETY AND QUALITY][152]

We care about the well-being of our employees, people in our supply chains, communities and
consumers. We strive to create a safe, healthy, inclusive and engaging work environment that fosters
innovation and continuous improvement, while prioritizing food safety and quality.

## OUR **PRODUCTS**

Our products include plant-based beverages, liquids and dry ingredients (using oat, almond, soy,
coconut and other bases) as well as broths, teas and nutritional beverages. We also manufacture
better-for-you snacks.

## **HOW WE GO TO MARKET**

With over 50 years of expertise, SunOpta fuels customers’ growth with high-quality,
sustainability-forward solutions distributed through retail, club, foodservice and e-commerce
channels across North America.

* Building a bright future for all Albertans
  
  # Alberta's Innovation Engine
  
  Alberta Innovates solves some of the province's biggest challenges by seeing beyond the possible.
  We support research and the growth of business. We help the startup community build new technology
  and drive new ideas.
  
  [ Browse Funding Opportunities ][61]
* News
  
  # Accelerating clinical trials to bring new treatments and technologies to Albertans
  
  Alberta Innovates is investing $322,000 into Alberta FAST, specifically into the improvement of
  clinical trial start-up times at the Universities of Alberta and Calgary. The goal is to make the
  start-up process four times faster.
  
  [ Read more ][62]

## Start Here

[Start Here to find funding and services from Alberta Innovates]

### Not sure where to start?

We'll walk you through the basics of grant funding and how to determine if you qualify.

[ Start Here ][63]

## How We Help

### Funding Programs

We fund projects that support the growth and diversity of Alberta’s economy. We provide a range of
grant funding programs targeted to different sectors and development stages.

[Learn More][64]

### Coaching & Support

Connect with our Technology Development Advisors (TDAs) for one-on-one guidance and community
connections, or reach out to our Regional Innovation Networks (RINs), entrepreneur-centric networks
that help businesses grow.

[Learn More][65]

### Applied Research

Our two subsidiaries, InnoTech Alberta and C-FER Technologies, provide a critical bridge in the
innovation system by linking research with government and industry needs, offering applied research,
facilities, and testing.

[Learn More][66]

## Current Priority Areas

We determine where research and innovation are needed to address provincial challenges, or where
there are opportunities to benefit Albertans.

[Clean Resource Technologies]

### Our Strategic Vision

We are uniquely positioned to improve the lives of Albertans today and for generations to come.

[Find out more][67]

### Strategic Initiatives

We identify gaps and opportunities to address provincial needs with targeted programs and services.

[See our initiatives][68]

### Services

Services to help innovators advance and commercialize their ideas at every stage.

[See our services][69]

## Who We Help

We provide non-dilutive funding and support for startups, small and medium-sized enterprises,
post-secondary institutions, and industry in all economic sectors.

  # Alberta's Innovation Engine
  
  Alberta Innovates solves some of the province's biggest challenges by seeing beyond the possible.
  We support research and the growth of business. We help the startup community build new technology
  and drive new ideas.
  
  [ Browse Funding Opportunities ][61]

  # Accelerating clinical trials to bring new treatments and technologies to Albertans
  
  Alberta Innovates is investing $322,000 into Alberta FAST, specifically into the improvement of
  clinical trial start-up times at the Universities of Alberta and Calgary. The goal is to make the
  start-up process four times faster.

## Start Here

[Start Here to find funding and services from Alberta Innovates]

### Not sure where to start?

We'll walk you through the basics of grant funding and how to determine if you qualify.

[ Start Here ][63]

## How We Help

### Funding Programs

We fund projects that support the growth and diversity of Alberta’s economy. We provide a range of
grant funding programs targeted to different sectors and development stages.

[Learn More][64]

### Coaching & Support

Connect with our Technology Development Advisors (TDAs) for one-on-one guidance and community
connections, or reach out to our Regional Innovation Networks (RINs), entrepreneur-centric networks
that help businesses grow.

[Learn More][65]

### Applied Research

Our two subsidiaries, InnoTech Alberta and C-FER Technologies, provide a critical bridge in the
innovation system by linking research with government and industry needs, offering applied research,
facilities, and testing.

[Learn More][66]

## Current Priority Areas

We determine where research and innovation are needed to address provincial challenges, or where
there are opportunities to benefit Albertans.

We are uniquely positioned to improve the lives of Albertans today and for generations to come.

We identify gaps and opportunities to address provincial needs with targeted programs and services.

[See our initiatives][68]

### Services

Services to help innovators advance and commercialize their ideas at every stage.

[See our services][69]

We provide non-dilutive funding and support for startups, small and medium-sized enterprises,

About Allseeds Group

## Allseeds Group Ensures the Efficient and Reliable Delivery of Ukrainian Vegetable Oil and Meal to
## the Global Markets

With our processing plant and logistics hub in the port of Pivdennyi, we offer premium transshipment

Activities

## From Field
## to Customer

[ Learn more ][13]

We run the full oilseeds value chain in one integrated flow: we procure seeds at origin, process
them into value-added products, store them securely, and deliver them worldwide by sea and rail.
Supported by active trading and risk management, we turn crops into reliable, traceable goods for
our customers – efficiently, transparently, and at scale.
* 01Procurement
  
  ## Reliable Raw Material Sourcing
  
  We procure oilseeds directly from farmers and offer competitive terms, timely payments, and
  professional service. All raw materials are controlled by an independent laboratory in accordance
  with European quality standards.
  * Direct sourcing
  * Verfied quality
  * European standards
* 02Processing
  
  ## Oilseed Crushing at Industrial Scale
  
  Our modern plant in Pivdennyi Port has a daily crushing capacity of 2,400 mt/day sunflower seeds,
  1,800 mt/day rapeseeds or 1,500 mt/day soybeans. The plant features world-class equipment from
  leading European manufacturers.
  * Modern equipment
  * High daily volumes
* 03Storage & Shipment
  
  ## Efficient Storage and Terminal Operations
  
  Allseeds offers quality transshipment at its own terminal, handling cargoes up to Panamax size (up
  to 65,000 mt). The terminal infrastructure provides loading capacities of up to 1,000 mt/hr for
  oils and 10,000 mt/day for dry cargo.
  * Unique location
  * High loading capacity
  * Logistic hub
* 04Trading
  
  ## Global Vegetable Oil & Meal Trading
  
  Allseeds supplies crude vegetable oils and meals to markets across the EU, India, China, North
  Africa, and the Middle East. Integrated logistics ensure a stable supply and consistent quality.

as “toxic” or “poisonous,” painting them as the culprit behind chronic disease. Influencers as
high-ranking as Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. warn against the harmful
health effects of the so-called “hateful eight” oils: canola, corn,…

Soybean oil dominates food, feed, and industrial markets around the world, comprising nearly a third
of global vegetable oil production. Although its widespread availability and relatively lower price
make it popular across various applications, conventional soybean oil also comes with major
drawbacks. As market demand shifts away from partially hydrogenated oil toward healthier fats, high…

The latest guidelines urge Americans to prioritize proteins, healthy fats, and produce while
avoiding highly processed foods. This dietary overhaul marks “the most significant…
[ READ MORE ][31]
[ View All Blogs ][32]

#### Complete systems for oilseed, synthetic rubber, and animal feed processing.

Put Anderson’s 135 years of engineering and installation experience to work for you when it comes
time to design a new processing system or make changes to existing installations.

[READ MORE][33]

Anderson has been a global leader for more than 135 years. Over the course of time, we have
designed, manufactured, and commissioned over 12,000 pieces of oil, polymer, and feed processing
equipment in more than 1,000 plant installations in over 100 countries — each one specifically
tailored to the customer’s unique needs. As an ISO-certified manufacturer, we stand by our products
and provide complete process support for the lifetime of our systems. Anderson has equipment
installations from the 1920s that are still in operation today!

## AVES GROUP

Turkiye's Largest Fully Integrated Oilseed Processing, Biodiesel and Peanut Production

With more than 30 years of experience in international commodity trade, Aves is one of the major
shareholders in Turkiye's crude sunflower oil supply and production through its companies around the
world, and operates in the fields of production and international trade of vegetable oils, raw
material supply and production of the feed sector, biodiesel production, vegetable oil and fuel
storage, peanut processing, real estate sector, port and terminal services.

## 1 MILLION TONS OF LOGISTICS SERVICE ANNUALLY

Aves, which provides strategic, fast and safe loading and unloading services to domestic and
international vegetable oil and fuel trading companies with its SAVKA Terminal, being Turkiye's
first and only offshore ship loading and unloading platform, complements the logistics advantage it
offers with the SAVKA Terminal with Turkiye's 3rd largest fuel and vegetable oil storage facility
located in Kazanlı.

## + 1 MILLION TONS OF COMMODITY TRADE ANNUALLY

Thanks to the systems it has created to create a value-added, innovative and sustainable product
range in every link of the food value chain, its offices in Russia, Ukraine, Switzerland, Dubai and
Romania, and its robust business partnerships, Aves procures products such as soybeans, sunflower
seeds, corn, safflower and wheat directly from the producers, and annually trades 1 million tons of
commodities with a high trade volume to more than 70 countries.

## Turkiye's award-winning taste Safya!

Safya and Ayzen branded edible oils produced by Aves, one of the largest 250 industrial enterprises
of our country, reinforce the brand commitment of “Same quality in the first bottle and in the
millionth bottle” with the power of technology and its investments.

## ZERO WASTE RECYCLING

AVES EXISTS FOR A CLEAN WORLD!

Our work for a sustainable world starts from the first stage of production. In our production
facility, where we have completed all the necessary infrastructure investments in order to prevent
environmental pollution, we continue our production without using any substances that are harmful to
human health. In order to prevent waste oils from mixing with water and to recycle them, we collect
vegetable waste oils and convert them into renewable energy - into biodiesel. Established on 200,000
m2 of land in Mersin, Aves produces 1 million tons of vegetable oil, meal and biodiesel per year
with a daily capacity of 500 tons of crushing, 700 tons of refining, and 1,100 tons of filling
capacity in Turkiye's largest fully integrated oilseed processing and biodiesel facility.

# Bulk Canadian Grain & Oilseed Supplier

Bennett’s Seed supplies bulk Canadian grains and oilseeds to global importers and Canadian buyers.
We source across Western Canada and coordinate grading, cleaning, and packaging through
pre-qualified partner facilities closest to origin, keeping freight efficient and documentation
consistent.

[ Contact Us][26]

## Built for Export. Ready for Canada.

### Global Importers

Export programs supported with destination-aligned documentation packs. We coordinate routing and
paperwork based on contract requirements and destination needs (e.g., phytosanitary, certificate of
origin, fumigation where applicable).
[ Contact us][27]

### Canadian Buyers

Domestic truck/rail programs for Canadian processors, ingredient buyers, and feed markets.
Consistent specifications, lot IDs, and shipment documentation per load, enabling traceability
audit-ready compliance scheduling transparency reliability nationwide.
[ Canadian Buyers][28]

## Certified Handling Through Regional Partners (Near Origin)

We do not rely on a single central facility. Instead, we fulfill program handling requirements
through a network of pre-qualified regional partner facilities closest to the originating farms.
This approach reduces unnecessary cross-province freight while keeping quality requirements and
documentation consistent across lots.

What you receive per lot (bullet list):

Facility certificate and scope (as applicable to the service performed)
Lot ID and shipment documents.
Sampling options and COA/lab results when requested.
Clear claims and resolution process.

[[Bennett's Canola]][29]
[[BNCP]][30]
[[Bennett's Beans]][31]
[[Bennett's Lentils]][32]
[[Bennett's Peas]][33]

## Lot-Based Quality & Documentation

Our programs are managed with practical controls buyers can verify:

Lot-based documentation and load-level records.
Sampling at load (and retained samples upon request)
Optional third-party lab testing aligned to contract specs.
Clear communication on spec tolerances and resolution steps if a lot is out of spec.

[ Contact us][34]
[Grain elevator]

## How a Supply Program Works

**Request & Specification**
Send product/spec, volume (MT), destination, packaging, and required certificates.
**Lot Allocation**
We allocate lots based on origin, timing, and program requirements.
**Partner Handling (if required)**
Grading/cleaning/packaging is coordinated through the nearest pre-qualified partner facility.
**Shipment & Documentation**
Each lot ships with the agreed documentation pack and traceability identifiers.

## Who We Supply

Global importers and traders.
Canadian processors and ingredient buyers.
Feed markets and bulk buyers.
Manufacturers requiring consistent program specifications

June 15, 2026 – The Canola Council of Canada (CCC) welcomes the release of the National Food
Security Strategy by the Government of Canada. Canada’s agriculture and agri-food sectors generally,
and the canola industry specifically, are strategic assets that drive economic growth and position
Canada as a global leader in food, feed and fuel. A…

[Read more][136]

## [Canola Council welcomes new chair and releases “Canola Forward, Together” 2025 Annual
## Report][137]

March 13, 2026 – The Canola Council of Canada’s (CCC) board of directors has named Kevin Wright as
chair. Wright is General Manager Great Lakes Region with ADM. Wright succeeds Tessa Ritter, who
completed her two-year term as chair. “On behalf of the board, I’d like to thank Tessa Ritter for
her service as our…

[Read more][138]

## [Farmer funding to drive innovation and strengthen canola production under Canola Agronomic
## Research Program in 2026][139]

March 4, 2026 – The three Prairie provincial canola grower associations have evaluated and selected
11 canola research projects to receive funding under the Canola Agronomic Research Program (CARP) in
2026. This investment includes over $2.4 million from Alberta Canola, SaskOilseeds and Manitoba
Canola Growers, as well as over $495,000 from the Western Grains Research Foundation…

[Read more][140]

Bins intended for canola storage must remain malathion-free. Keep it Clean and the CCC are reminding
growers that malathion residues can transfer to canola and put your crop's marketability at risk.

# Oilseed products

## A trusted supplier of quality ingredients

CHS adds value to growers' crops through our soybean and canola crushing and refining facilities and
animal feed mills. The high-quality ingredients we generate provide customers with a consistent,
year-round supply.

[canola]
Canola

We produce crude and refined canola oil and high-protein canola meal at our processing and refining
facility near Hallock, Minn.

  
* [Learn about canola processing][62]

[soybeans]
Soybeans

We produce soybean oil, flour and meal for global food companies. Our trusted brands include
Honeysoy^{®} and Savorysoy^{®}. We also produce PlastiSoy^{®} epoxidized soy oil, used in food wrap
and medical applications.
* [Learn about soybean processing][63]

[sunflower seeds]
Sunflowers

We export sunflower products to Spain, Greece, Poland and Israel and supply ingredients to
nationally known snack brands.

 
* [Learn about growing sunflowers][64]
* [Learn about buying sunflowers][65]

[Green crops in a field]

## Oilseed products

CHS produces a variety of food and feed ingredients for customers around the world. We are a leader
in soybean and canola processing and refine more than 1.7 billion pounds of soybean oil and process
21 million bushels of canola seed each year at our crushing and refining facilities in Minnesota.
From refined soybean oil to high-protein canola meal, we are committed to helping our producers find
new markets and uses for their grain.

# LEADER IN GRAIN AND OIL MACHINERY

Huatai Intelligent Equipment Group has 38 years of dedicated grain and oil machinery development.
And established cooperative relationships with customers in more than 70 countries.

## GREAT QUALITY ARE ALL IN HUATAI

After nearly 38 years of dedicated development, Huatai Intelligent Equipment Group has gradually
developed into a leading brand in the grain and oil machinery industry. Provide customized solutions
for oil and fat engineering solutions, protein engineering, feed starch engineering, grain
processing engineering, sewage treatment engineering, and other industries. We have established
cooperative relationships with customers in more than 70 countries to help them plan reasonable
solutions.

[About Huatai Intelligent Equipment Group]

## SUITABLE SOLUTIONS FOR BETTER

Create high-quality solutions with ingenuity, achieve customers, and create a better future.
* [Edible Oil Engineering]
  
  ### Edible Oil Engineering
  
  As a leading brand in China's grain and oil industry, Huatai Group can provide customers with
  30-5000 TPD one-stop turnkey intelligent oil production line solutions for oil pretreatment, oil
  solvent extraction, oil refining, and other processes. We can also provide a full set of equipment
  and production line programs for subcritical low-temperature extraction, animal oil refining, and
  biodiesel equipment.
* [Edible Oil Production Line]
  
  ### Edible Oil Production Line
  
  Huatai Group can provide customers with professional customized oil production line services and a
  full set of professional production line solutions for different oil materials and oil product
  needs. Advanced process design, reasonable equipment structure design, and automated technical
  supporting equipment protect the actual interests of customers. At present, Huatai Group has built
  more than 100 intelligent oil and fat factories around the world.
* [Grains And Flour Engineering]
  
  ### Grains And Flour Engineering
  
  Henan Huatai Grain Division has a complete service chain integrating scientific research, design,
  equipment manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and training. Business includes preliminary
  scheme design, process electrical construction drawing design, and general equipment
  manufacturing, installation, and commissioning contracting.

After nearly 38 years of dedicated development, Huatai Intelligent Equipment Group has gradually
developed into a leading brand in the grain and oil machinery industry. Provide customized solutions
for oil and fat engineering solutions, protein engineering, feed starch engineering, grain
processing engineering, sewage treatment engineering, and other industries. We have established
cooperative relationships with customers in more than 70 countries to help them plan reasonable

## SUITABLE SOLUTIONS FOR BETTER

Create high-quality solutions with ingenuity, achieve customers, and create a better future.
* [Edible Oil Engineering]
  
  ### Edible Oil Engineering
  
  As a leading brand in China's grain and oil industry, Huatai Group can provide customers with
  30-5000 TPD one-stop turnkey intelligent oil production line solutions for oil pretreatment, oil
  solvent extraction, oil refining, and other processes. We can also provide a full set of equipment
  and production line programs for subcritical low-temperature extraction, animal oil refining, and
  biodiesel equipment.
* [Edible Oil Production Line]
  
  ### Edible Oil Production Line
  
  Huatai Group can provide customers with professional customized oil production line services and a
  full set of professional production line solutions for different oil materials and oil product
  needs. Advanced process design, reasonable equipment structure design, and automated technical
  supporting equipment protect the actual interests of customers. At present, Huatai Group has built
  more than 100 intelligent oil and fat factories around the world.
* [Grains And Flour Engineering]
  
  ### Grains And Flour Engineering
  
  Henan Huatai Grain Division has a complete service chain integrating scientific research, design,
  equipment manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and training. Business includes preliminary
  scheme design, process electrical construction drawing design, and general equipment
  manufacturing, installation, and commissioning contracting.
* [Starch And Protein Engineering]
  
  ### Starch And Protein Engineering
  
  Huatai Group has innovative research and development and has a complete set of starch and protein
  series production line equipment and solutions. Huatai integrates three-dimensional drawing into
  engineering design and simulates actual engineering to ensure the rationality of engineering
  installation and greatly shorten the project construction and installation cycle.
* [Feed Production Line]
  
  ### Feed Production Line
  
  Huatai Feed Division mainly provides complete feed production line projects with an output of 1-30
  tons per hour, including livestock and poultry feed and fish feed. Committed to becoming the
  leader in overall solutions for farm animal feed production equipment and improving animal
  nutrition.
  
  [LEARN MORE][78]
* [Wastewater Treatment Solution]
  
  ### Wastewater Treatment Solution
  
  Based on its R&D strength, Huatai has advanced treatment technologies in the fields of
  pharmaceutical and chemical wastewater, zero discharge of chemical wastewater, Hospital medical
  sewage treatment, grain and oil processing wastewater, soybean protein isolate wastewater, corn
  starch wastewater, slaughtering and meat processing wastewater, food processing wastewater,
  alcohol wastewater, domestic sewage, odor gas treatment and sludge dewatering and reduction
  treatment.
  
  [LEARN MORE][79]

The Ethiopian Pulses, Oilseeds and Spices Processors-Exporters Association (EPOSPEA), which revised
its name to be Ethiopian Pulses and Oilseeds Exporters Association (EPOSEA) at the current fiscal
year, was established in 1998 with the objective of building the capacity of the industry players to
become key participants’ role players in the global market.

its name to be Ethiopian Pulses and Oilseeds Exporters Association (EPOSEA) at the current fiscal

## Membership Advantages

Members will be equipped with sufficient knowledge in their field. Training sessions that support
their export activities will be provided in collaboration with governmental and non-governmental
organizations. Efforts will be made to resolve challenges members face in their export business by
engaging with relevant governmental and non-governmental entities.
* ## Networking
  
  To find local and foreign markets for their products and services
* ## Capacity Building
  
  In the area of training, manual preparation, strategic plan document designing, and the like
* ## Consultancy
  
  Membership and business development consultancy
* ## Experience Sharing
  
  Exchange information and share experience etc.

## How to become a member

Applicant’s should have a valid renewed export license and a TIN number
* Membership registration fee of 40,000 birr and
* Annual contribution fee of 15,000 birr; totally 55,000 birr should be paid.

A membership request form provided by the association should be filled, signed and stamped.

### Industrial Automation solutions across multiple industries

ESCO Automation provides industrial automation and control system integration solutions for a
diverse range of industries across the United States.

[View All Industries][32]

Food & Beverage

Reliable automation that supports production consistency, sanitation standards, and regulatory
compliance in fast-paced processing environments.

[Learn More][33]

Water / Wastewater

Smart control and monitoring systems that improve efficiency, reporting, and reliability for
critical municipal and utility infrastructure

[Learn More][34]

Discrete Manufacturing

We support discrete manufacturers with automation, integration, and plant services that streamline
production, improve safety, and enable scalability

[Learn More][35]

[water treatment automation]

Iowa City Launches Major Wastewater Treatment Facility Digester Rehabilitation Project

This project represents a significant investment in the city’s wastewater treatment system,
supporting reliable service, environmental stewardship, and long-term growth.

[ Learn More ][36]
[modernizing legacy systems]

Modernizing Legacy Systems: PLC-5 to ControlLogix Conversion

In a strategic move to modernize aging infrastructure, an ESCO customer initiated a two-phase
upgrade of one of their critical control systems that feeds raw product into the plant,
transitioning from a legacy PLC-5 system communicating on Data Highway Plus (DH+) to a ControlLogix
platform using Ethernet/IP.

[ Learn More ][37]
[future of manufacturing]

Tomorrow’s Robotics: Flexibility for the Future of Manufacturing

Universal Robots makes collaborative robots that work well in spaces requiring human access.

[ Learn More ][38]
[plant automation]

Is Your Plant As Smart As You Are?

What if a world existed, where you could easily review production data, quality data, planned versus
unplanned downtime all in one place, readily at your fingertips? It does… read on.

[ Learn More ][39]
[digital transformation]

7 Steps to a Successful Digital Transformation

Beginning a digital transformation can be a daunting task. Jargon and buzzwords confuse us to the
point that we’re not sure what to do first, or what some of the technologies can do for us.

[ Learn More ][40]

About Us

#### ESCO Automation is a full-service control systems integration firm supporting a wide range of
#### industries with reliable, results-driven solutions.

[Learn More][41]

From project planning to implementation and long-term support, the team delivers technical expertise
and responsive service at every stage. Backed by a values-driven culture and people-focused
approach, ESCO Automation helps clients operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

[esco automation]

Have a question or want to connect? We’d love to hear from you. Send us a message and we’ll get back
to you soon.

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

Собрали для вас самые популярные вопросы, которые клиенты задают чаще всего.

### Какие сельскохозяйственные культуры вы продаёте?

Мы продаём зерновые, бобовые и масличные культуры, а также продукты их переработки. В нашем
ассортименте представлены пшеница, ячмень, кукуруза, соя, подсолнечник и рапс. Кроме того, мы
предлагаем муку, жмых, масло, шрот и крупы. Продукция проходит строгий контроль качества, что
позволяет нам гарантировать её соответствие международным стандартам.

### Какие страны вы обслуживаете?

Мы экспортируем нашу продукцию более чем в 50 стран мира, включая Германию, Италию, Испанию,
Францию, ОАЭ, Саудовскую Аравию, Турцию, Китай, Индию, Японию, Южную Корею, Казахстан, Узбекистан,
Беларусь, Египет, Алжир, Марокко и другие. Для получения информации о возможностях экспорта в ваш
регион, свяжитесь с нашим менеджером — он предоставит все необходимые детали. Мы готовы к
сотрудничеству и расширению географии поставок.

### Работаете ли вы с небольшими объемами или только с крупным оптом?

Мы готовы работать не только с крупным оптом, но и с небольшими объемами. Наша компания
ориентирована на гибкость и удовлетворение потребностей каждого клиента, независимо от размера
заказа. Мы всегда найдем оптимальные условия для вас, обеспечив высокое качество и своевременную
доставку.

### Можно ли заказать пробную партию продукции?

Да, вы можете заказать пробную партию продукции. Мы понимаем, что для многих клиентов важно оценить
качество товара перед заключением сделки, и всегда готовы предоставить небольшие партии для
тестирования. Свяжитесь с нами для уточнения деталей и условий заказа.

### Как вы гарантируете качество зерна и других культур?

Мы тщательно контролируем качество зерна и других культур на всех этапах — от сбора урожая до
поставки. Для гарантии высочайшего качества продукции мы сотрудничаем с ведущими международными
организациями по контролю качества, такими как Baltic Control и SGS, которые проводят независимую
оценку и тестирование. Это обеспечивает соответствие нашей продукции мировым стандартам.

### Какие условия доставки вы предлагаете?

Основные условия доставки, которые мы предлагаем, — это FCA (Incoterms 2020). Однако мы готовы
рассматривать и другие условия, в зависимости от ваших потребностей и требований. Наши специалисты
помогут подобрать наиболее удобные и выгодные условия доставки для каждого конкретного случая.

### Можете ли вы организовать доставку с таможенным оформлением?

Да, мы можем организовать доставку с полным таможенным оформлением. Мы заботимся о том, чтобы
процесс доставки был максимально удобным для наших клиентов, включая все необходимые документы и
разрешения. Наши специалисты помогут вам пройти все этапы таможенного оформления быстро и без лишних
хлопот.

### Можете ли вы работать с индивидуальными требованиями клиента?

Да, мы готовы работать с индивидуальными требованиями каждого клиента. Мы ценим уникальные
потребности наших партнёров и всегда стараемся предложить гибкие решения, которые максимально
соответствуют вашим запросам. Свяжитесь с нами, и мы обсудим детали вашего заказа, чтобы предложить
оптимальные условия.

### Предоставляете ли вы услуги хранения и переработки?

Да, мы предоставляем услуги хранения и переработки продукции. Мы обеспечиваем надежные условия для
хранения сельскохозяйственных культур и предлагаем различные виды переработки, включая производство
муки, масла, шрота и других продуктов. Это позволяет нашим клиентам получить продукцию, готовую к
дальнейшему использованию или продаже.

### Можно ли забронировать объёмы урожая заранее на будущий сезон?

Да, вы можете забронировать объёмы урожая заранее на будущий сезон. Мы предлагаем гибкие условия для
долгосрочного планирования и готовы заранее зафиксировать нужные объемы продукции, чтобы вы могли
обеспечить бесперебойные поставки в течение года. Свяжитесь с нами для уточнения деталей.

### Можно ли организовать самовывоз продукции с вашего склада?

Да, вы можете организовать самовывоз продукции с нашего склада. Мы предоставляем все необходимые
условия для удобного забора товара. Свяжитесь с нами, чтобы согласовать дату и время, а также
уточнить детали логистики.

### Отправляете ли вы на экспорт?

Да, мы занимаемся оптовыми поставками зерновых (пшеница, ячмень, кукуруза), бобовых (нут, фасоль,
горох) и масличных культур (подсолнечник, рапс, соя). Мы обеспечиваем надежную и своевременную
доставку продукции на экспорт, гарантируя её качество и соответствие международным стандартам.

### Какие документы на продукцию у вас имеются?

Мы предоставляем все необходимые документы на продукцию, включая счёт-фактуру, накладную, паспорт
качества, фитосанитарный сертификат и таможенную декларацию. Эти документы подтверждают соответствие
нашей продукции международным стандартам и обеспечивают прозрачность сделок.

## Часто задаваемые вопросы

Собрали для вас самые популярные вопросы, которые клиенты задают чаще всего.

### Какие сельскохозяйственные культуры вы продаёте?

Мы продаём зерновые, бобовые и масличные культуры, а также продукты их переработки. В нашем
ассортименте представлены пшеница, ячмень, кукуруза, соя, подсолнечник и рапс. Кроме того, мы
предлагаем муку, жмых, масло, шрот и крупы. Продукция проходит строгий контроль качества, что
позволяет нам гарантировать её соответствие международным стандартам.

### Какие страны вы обслуживаете?

Мы экспортируем нашу продукцию более чем в 50 стран мира, включая Германию, Италию, Испанию,
Францию, ОАЭ, Саудовскую Аравию, Турцию, Китай, Индию, Японию, Южную Корею, Казахстан, Узбекистан,
Беларусь, Египет, Алжир, Марокко и другие. Для получения информации о возможностях экспорта в ваш
регион, свяжитесь с нашим менеджером — он предоставит все необходимые детали. Мы готовы к
сотрудничеству и расширению географии поставок.

### Работаете ли вы с небольшими объемами или только с крупным оптом?

Мы готовы работать не только с крупным оптом, но и с небольшими объемами. Наша компания
ориентирована на гибкость и удовлетворение потребностей каждого клиента, независимо от размера
заказа. Мы всегда найдем оптимальные условия для вас, обеспечив высокое качество и своевременную
доставку.

### Можно ли заказать пробную партию продукции?

Да, вы можете заказать пробную партию продукции. Мы понимаем, что для многих клиентов важно оценить
качество товара перед заключением сделки, и всегда готовы предоставить небольшие партии для
тестирования. Свяжитесь с нами для уточнения деталей и условий заказа.

### Как вы гарантируете качество зерна и других культур?

Мы тщательно контролируем качество зерна и других культур на всех этапах — от сбора урожая до
поставки. Для гарантии высочайшего качества продукции мы сотрудничаем с ведущими международными
организациями по контролю качества, такими как Baltic Control и SGS, которые проводят независимую
оценку и тестирование. Это обеспечивает соответствие нашей продукции мировым стандартам.

### Какие условия доставки вы предлагаете?

Основные условия доставки, которые мы предлагаем, — это FCA (Incoterms 2020). Однако мы готовы
рассматривать и другие условия, в зависимости от ваших потребностей и требований. Наши специалисты
помогут подобрать наиболее удобные и выгодные условия доставки для каждого конкретного случая.

### Можете ли вы организовать доставку с таможенным оформлением?

Да, мы можем организовать доставку с полным таможенным оформлением. Мы заботимся о том, чтобы
процесс доставки был максимально удобным для наших клиентов, включая все необходимые документы и
разрешения. Наши специалисты помогут вам пройти все этапы таможенного оформления быстро и без лишних
хлопот.

### Можете ли вы работать с индивидуальными требованиями клиента?

Да, мы готовы работать с индивидуальными требованиями каждого клиента. Мы ценим уникальные
потребности наших партнёров и всегда стараемся предложить гибкие решения, которые максимально
соответствуют вашим запросам. Свяжитесь с нами, и мы обсудим детали вашего заказа, чтобы предложить
оптимальные условия.

### Предоставляете ли вы услуги хранения и переработки?

Да, мы предоставляем услуги хранения и переработки продукции. Мы обеспечиваем надежные условия для
хранения сельскохозяйственных культур и предлагаем различные виды переработки, включая производство
муки, масла, шрота и других продуктов. Это позволяет нашим клиентам получить продукцию, готовую к
дальнейшему использованию или продаже.

### Можно ли забронировать объёмы урожая заранее на будущий сезон?

Да, вы можете забронировать объёмы урожая заранее на будущий сезон. Мы предлагаем гибкие условия для
долгосрочного планирования и готовы заранее зафиксировать нужные объемы продукции, чтобы вы могли
обеспечить бесперебойные поставки в течение года. Свяжитесь с нами для уточнения деталей.

### Можно ли организовать самовывоз продукции с вашего склада?

Да, вы можете организовать самовывоз продукции с нашего склада. Мы предоставляем все необходимые
условия для удобного забора товара. Свяжитесь с нами, чтобы согласовать дату и время, а также
уточнить детали логистики.

### Отправляете ли вы на экспорт?

Да, мы занимаемся оптовыми поставками зерновых (пшеница, ячмень, кукуруза), бобовых (нут, фасоль,
горох) и масличных культур (подсолнечник, рапс, соя). Мы обеспечиваем надежную и своевременную
доставку продукции на экспорт, гарантируя её качество и соответствие международным стандартам.

### Какие документы на продукцию у вас имеются?

Мы предоставляем все необходимые документы на продукцию, включая счёт-фактуру, накладную, паспорт
качества, фитосанитарный сертификат и таможенную декларацию. Эти документы подтверждают соответствие
нашей продукции международным стандартам и обеспечивают прозрачность сделок.

# Why Export and Market Development Programs Underperform

Many programs succeed in building awareness and capacity, but struggle to achieve sustained market
participation.


Common challenges include:
* weak alignment between products and target markets
* fragmented compliance and quality systems
* limited access to structured buyer networks
* lack of coordination across value chain actors.


As a result, SMEs remain trained, but not integrated into functioning market systems.

# What We Do Differently

Export Mentor works at the intersection of export development and market systems development.


We design interventions that connect:
* SMEs and producer groups
* service providers and institutions
* buyers and market channels

into structured, functioning export systems.


Our focus is not only on capacity building, but on enabling real participation in market systems.

# Market-Oriented Export System Design

Our approach combines export development with market systems thinking.


We structure interventions across five operational phases:
* Diagnostic, assessment of constraints at firm and system level
* Product and Market Alignment, linking supply with real demand
* Compliance Structuring, enabling access to target markets
* Market Entry Strategy, defining viable commercial pathways
* Buyer Engagement, activating direct market interaction

 

This creates a coherent pathway from local production to international markets.

#courses

## Strengthening Market Systems, Not Only Firms

Our interventions go beyond individual SMEs.


We support:
* coordination between value chain actors
* development of aggregation and service models
* alignment with institutional frameworks
* strengthening of market linkages


The objective is to enable sustainable, scalable participation in export markets.

#courses

## From Capacity to Market Access

Market access is addressed as a structured process, not an isolated activity.


We support:
* identification of target buyers and segments
* development of market-aligned commercial offers
* preparation for professional communication and negotiation
* structured buyer outreach and engagement

 

This ensures that SMEs are not only prepared, but positioned to enter markets effectively.

#courses

## For Trade and Development Programs

We work with:

* trade promotion organizations
* ministries and public institutions
* development agencies and donor-funded programs


supporting export development, sector competitiveness, and market systems strengthening.

# From Export Readiness to
# Market Systems Activation

We design and implement export and market access systems that enable SMEs to participate effectively
in international markets.


Supporting trade institutions and development programs in delivering measurable, system-level
outcomes.

Explore Programs

# Why Export and Market Development Programs Underperform

Many programs succeed in building awareness and capacity, but struggle to achieve sustained market
participation.


Common challenges include:
* weak alignment between products and target markets
* fragmented compliance and quality systems
* limited access to structured buyer networks
* lack of coordination across value chain actors.


As a result, SMEs remain trained, but not integrated into functioning market systems.

# What We Do Differently

Export Mentor works at the intersection of export development and market systems development.


We design interventions that connect:
* SMEs and producer groups
* service providers and institutions
* buyers and market channels

into structured, functioning export systems.


Our focus is not only on capacity building, but on enabling real participation in market systems.

# Market-Oriented Export System Design

Our approach combines export development with market systems thinking.


We structure interventions across five operational phases:
* Diagnostic, assessment of constraints at firm and system level
* Product and Market Alignment, linking supply with real demand
* Compliance Structuring, enabling access to target markets
* Market Entry Strategy, defining viable commercial pathways
* Buyer Engagement, activating direct market interaction

 

This creates a coherent pathway from local production to international markets.

#courses

## Strengthening Market Systems, Not Only Firms

Our interventions go beyond individual SMEs.


We support:
* coordination between value chain actors
* development of aggregation and service models
* alignment with institutional frameworks
* strengthening of market linkages


The objective is to enable sustainable, scalable participation in export markets.

#courses

## From Capacity to Market Access

Market access is addressed as a structured process, not an isolated activity.


We support:
* identification of target buyers and segments
* development of market-aligned commercial offers
* preparation for professional communication and negotiation
* structured buyer outreach and engagement

 

This ensures that SMEs are not only prepared, but positioned to enter markets effectively.

#courses

## For Trade and Development Programs

We work with:

* trade promotion organizations
* ministries and public institutions
* development agencies and donor-funded programs


supporting export development, sector competitiveness, and market systems strengthening.

# Advocating for simple and reliable global trading in oils, seeds and fats

FOSFA International is a trade federation that operates on behalf of its members. We provide
standard contract forms and supporting services that are the foundation for fair and transparent
global free trade in oils, oilseeds and fats. 

Over 1,200 members – representing buyers, sellers, producers and processors, analysts, surveyors and
brokers – operating from 90 countries rely on our services to confidently execute contracts and keep
the shipping and transportation of commodities simple and reliable. 

Utilising the knowledge and expertise of our membership network, our standards and policies are
overseen by an elected [Council,][270] and our contracts and supporting services are managed by
specialist [committees][271] that are made up of representatives from all aspects of the supply
chain. 

FOSFA International is for the trade, by the trade and with the trade.

## Supporting members since 1971

FOSFA was established in 1971 on the values of independence, fairness and impartiality. We have
always given members reassurance that FOSFA contracts are relevant so the trade of vegetable and
animal oils and fats, oilseeds, and their derivatives can remain uncomplicated. 
Our six membership categories – trading, non-trading, analyst, superintendent, broker and kindred
associations – cover every aspect of the supply chain, and by joining FOSFA, our members: 
* Have unlimited access to our standard contract forms
* Receive free digital access to a comprehensive library of publications, manuals, codes of practice
  and useful resources
* Can contact and network with other members through our Members Directory
* Benefit from our impartial arbitration service that ensures disputes are resolved in a timely and
  efficient manner 
* Can contribute to changes in policies, rules and procedures by joining a committee
* Receive discounts on our residential training courses

# Contact Customer Service & Fix Issues with Ease

## Free tools that help you talk and write to companies & state agencies

Type a company name...Search

### We help you talk to customer service

GetHuman builds free tools to help you solve customer service problems more easily.

Our free phone can navigate phone menus, wait on hold, or talk to an agent for you.

[We will talk to customer service or wait on hold for you for free if you like]
[Re-schedule a customer service phone call when a call center is busy or closed]

Automatically re-schedule calls when a call center is busy or closed.

Read a summary of your customer service phone call and easily re-try afterward.

Some companies don't offer live customer service, but we can still help.

With a hint from you, we can write that email, tweet, or message to their customer team.

[GetHuman will write an email, tweet, or message to customer service for you]

## Our technology is free and built to help you

Businesses spend a LOT of money building elaborate mazes to "handle" customer issues.

But we don't think it should cost you time or money to get help with their products.

[Our tools help contact customer service at major companies for free]
[Our human team researches customer operations, then builds tools and shares information to save you
time]

We research customer service contact information and build tools to help consumers.

Our work is ad-supported, meaning we provide tools and information to you for free.

## Finally: AI that actually helps you!

Our very human team calls customer service phone numbers constantly.

We hand-write all our articles about contact information and how to solve customer issues.

[The content on our web-site is 100% written and researched by humans, not AI]
[But we use AI to have difficult conversations with customer service for you, wait on hold for you,
and other tasks that many people find difficult or annoying]

But we think AI can help with the annoying and mundane parts of being a customer.

We use Google Gemini™ and other leading AI technology to save you time.

Forget hype and doomsday predictions- our AI ACTUALLY helps you with everyday problems.

## GetHuman is trusted by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide

Since GetHuman published its first list of company phone numbers and the fastest path to a live
human in 2005, we've been written about by every major national news corporation.

CNBC]][4][[GetHuman was in the Forbes]][5][[GetHuman was in the CNN]][6][[GetHuman was in the

lifehacker]][9][[GetHuman was in the Los Angeles Times]][10]

# Экспорт бобовых и масличных культур крупным оптом

**Artisolla (GrainRU)** - надёжный экспортер из России высококачественных бобовых, масличных и
зерновых культур уже более 15 лет.

**Производство, переработка, хранение и реализация зерновых и масличных культур на внутреннем и
внешнем рынках.**

Мы занимаемся оптовой и крупно-оптовой поставкой таких продуктов, как: чечевица, нут, лен, соя,
горчица, сафлор, подсолнечник, просо и др.
**Наши основные рынки** - Турция, Иран, Пакистан, Германия, Великобритания, Франция, Италия,
Словакия, Чехия, Венгрия, Болгария, Белоруссия, Финляндия, Эстония, Албания, Греция, Сербия и другие
страны.
**Мы гарантируем высокое качество продукции и своевременные поставки.**
Свяжитесь с нами для получения коммерческого предложения и начала долгосрочного партнерства.

**Мы ориентированы на долгосрочные отношения, в основе которых лежит доверие и ответственность! **

##### FROM CHAIRPERSON’S DESK

Dear Friends,
The global economic environment in 2026 carries the unmistakable weight of prolonged uncertainty.
Geopolitical tensions in West Asia continue to reverberate across international trade.

It is in precisely such moments...

#### WELCOME TO INDIAN OILSEEDS AND
#### PRODUCE EXPORT PROMOTION COUNCIL

Indian Oilseed and Produce Export Promotion Council (IOPEPC) is concerned with the promotion of
various Oilseeds and Oils.

Formerly known as IOPEA, it was formed on 23 rd June 1956, at a preliminary meeting held in Bombay
under the Presidentship of late Shri Lalji Mehrotra, former President of Federation of Indian
Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) and India's one time ambassador to Myanmar and Japan... [
Read more ][73]

#### Services

[

## MEMBERSHIP

Elevate your business with IOPEPC's exclusive membership, offering unparalleled benefits such as
market insights, networking opportunities, and trade representation in the oilseed and oil export
industry.

][77]
[

### RCMC CERTIFICATE

Firms applying for import/export benefits under the Foreign Trade Policy require a valid
Registration Cum Membership Certificate (RCMC) from IOPEPC, obtainable through offline or online
application.

][78]
[

#### ARBITRATION

Arbitration, a key Alternative Dispute Resolution method, uniquely resolves business disputes
outside traditional legal systems. With binding agreements and final decisions, it ensures a swift
and enforceable closure, making it an efficient choice for dispute resolution.

][79]
[

#### CERTIFICATE OF ORIGIN

Certify the origin of goods with a Certificate of Origin, a crucial international trade document.
Whether for duty assessment, legal importation, or compliance with Letters of Credit, COOs play a
pivotal role in establishing the origin of exported goods.

## ***PRODUCTION LINE***

Color Sorting Production Line

For various materials, the standard processing capacity is 5 tons per hour,while higher capacity
options can handle 10 tons per hour, both based on 99% purity.
[learn more +][82]
[ISORT YM Production Line Section Image – 3D Model Render of Color Sorting Production Line, Front
View with Multi Grains & Beans (Red Beans, Soybeans, Lentils, Mung Beans) to Show Multi-Raw Material
Sorting Function]

Sunflower Seed Dehulling and Sorting Production

This is the line of sunflower seeds dehulling with 12 tons per hour, and kernel selecting by
selecting machine to get the highest quality 99.99% purity as confectionary or bakery standard.
[learn more +][83]
[ISORT YM Production Line Section Image – 3D Model Render of Sunflower Seed Dehulling and Sorting
Production Line, Front View with Sunflower Seeds to Demonstrate Dehulling & Sorting Integration
Function]

Sunflower Seeds Shelling Production Line

The sunflower seeds shelling prodution includes stone removing and seeds grading as precleaning
part, and 6 sets of dehulling machines to get materials of oil pressing.
[learn more +][84]
[ISORT YM Production Line Section Image – 3D Model Render of Sunflower Seeds Shelling Production
Line, Front View with Oil Sunflower Seeds to Demonstrate Professional Shelling Process]

Oil Pressing and Refining Production Line

The line includes raw materials pre-cleaning by Destoner, seeds pressing by Oil Expeller and Oil
Extraction by Membrance Filer and Refining Tanks with 40 tons per day.
[learn more +][85]
[ISORT YM Production Line Section Image – 3D Model Render of Oil Pressing and Refining Production
Line, Front View with Rapeseeds to Demonstrate Pressing & Refining Integration Process]

Chili PAper Sorting Production

The customizable production for chili selecting with 4 tons per hour, and equit chili steam cutting
machine and color sorter according to finished product quality.
[learn more +][86]

# ABOUT ISORT YM

[ISORT YM About Us Page Certificate – Shows "Specialized, Refined, Peculiar & Innovative SME" Title
& Issued by Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Industry and Information Technology Department,
Enhancing Credibility of Seed and Grain Processing Equipment Business][ISORT YM About Us Page
Certificate – Shows "High-Tech Enterprise" Title & Issued by Relevant Competent Authorities, Proving
Technological Strength in Seed and Grain Processing Equipment R&D]

Established in 2004 and headquartered in Inner Mongolia, China — a major sunflower seed region —
ISORT YM (Yongming Machinery) is an innovative supplier of grain-cleaning, seed-shelling and related
accessories.

For 20 years, we have specialised in improving the food-grade quality of industrial products.

In 2018, our company obtained 80% of the seed shelling machine market share in China. Concurrently,
we initiated international trade activities and successfully obtained ISO 9001 international quality
system certification. Our products are also certified to the European CE 0865 standard. To date, we
have provided over 10,000 clients worldwide with high-quality grain processing solutions, supported
by our 40,000 m² facility.

Sunflower Seed Dehulling and Sorting Production

This is the line of sunflower seeds dehulling with 12 tons per hour, and kernel selecting by
selecting machine to get the highest quality 99.99% purity as confectionary or bakery standard.
[learn more +][83]
[ISORT YM Production Line Section Image – 3D Model Render of Sunflower Seed Dehulling and Sorting

Function]

Sunflower Seeds Shelling Production Line

The sunflower seeds shelling prodution includes stone removing and seeds grading as precleaning
part, and 6 sets of dehulling machines to get materials of oil pressing.
[learn more +][84]
[ISORT YM Production Line Section Image – 3D Model Render of Sunflower Seeds Shelling Production
Line, Front View with Oil Sunflower Seeds to Demonstrate Professional Shelling Process]

Oil Pressing and Refining Production Line

Extraction by Membrance Filer and Refining Tanks with 40 tons per day.

Established in 2004 and headquartered in Inner Mongolia, China — a major sunflower seed region —
ISORT YM (Yongming Machinery) is an innovative supplier of grain-cleaning, seed-shelling and related
accessories.

For 20 years, we have specialised in improving the food-grade quality of industrial products.

In 2018, our company obtained 80% of the seed shelling machine market share in China. Concurrently,
we initiated international trade activities and successfully obtained ISO 9001 international quality
system certification. Our products are also certified to the European CE 0865 standard. To date, we
have provided over 10,000 clients worldwide with high-quality grain processing solutions, supported
by our 40,000 m² facility.

Is MindMap AI free? +

## Frequently asked questions

Is MindMap AI free? +

Yes. The free plan gives you unlimited mind maps with AI-powered creation and basic exports. No
credit card needed. Paid plans add more AI credits, export formats, and larger uploads.

How do I create a mind map with AI? +

Type a prompt, upload a file, or paste notes. MindMap AI reads your input, shows its thinking, then
builds a mind map in seconds. Chat with AI to expand or refine. Works on any device. No download
needed.

What can I turn into a mind map? +

Prompts, PDFs, images, audio recordings, video files, meeting transcripts, Markdown, CSV, and
webpages via the browser extension.

How is MindMap AI different from other mind mapping software? +

Most mind mapping software gives you a blank canvas or a one-time AI output. MindMap AI works with
you the whole way — chat to expand, refine, and reshape without losing your work.

Can I import mind maps from other tools? +

Yes. All major mind mapping formats are supported.

Can I share and export my mind maps? +

Yes. Export as PDF, PNG, SVG, CSV, Markdown, or .mma. Share via email, private link, or public link.
Team workspaces with admin controls.

Does MindMap AI work on mobile? +

Yes. Native iOS and Android apps, plus a web app and browser extensions. Maps sync across all
devices.

process takes place where kernels are mechanically extracted, and the protective coating removed.
Finally, kernels are packed into vacuums and stored in temperature-controlled warehouse.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are oilseeds and their importance?

Oilseeds are crops grown primarily for their oil-rich seeds, which are crucial for producing edible
oils, biofuels, and animal feed. They play a significant role in agriculture and the global economy,
contributing to food security and renewable energy sources.

### How can process improvement benefit oilseed refining?

Process improvement in oilseed refining enhances efficiency, reduces waste, and increases yield. By
optimizing processes, companies can lower production costs, improve product quality, and minimize
environmental impact, leading to sustainable operations and higher profitability.

### What engineering services do you offer for biofuels?

We provide comprehensive engineering services tailored to biofuels, including process design,
optimization, and technology integration to enhance production efficiency and sustainability.

### Why is sustainability important in agriculture?

Sustainability in agriculture ensures that farming practices meet current needs without compromising
future generations. It promotes environmental health, economic viability, and social equity,
essential for long-term food security and resource management.

### What role does technology play in oil extraction?

Technology significantly enhances oil extraction processes by improving efficiency and yield.
Advanced techniques, such as solvent extraction and mechanical pressing, reduce energy consumption
and environmental impact, making oil production more sustainable and economically viable.
